card.name: Words inside repeated stock phrases
card.fires_on: Single linking words or symbols inside fixed, often-repeated sentences, such as 'following' in the opioid adrenal insufficiency sentence or the tokens of the browser-compliance note.

modes.label: Adrenal insufficiency sentence
modes.description: The word 'following' in the stock opioid warning 'more often following greater than one month of use'.
modes.example: Cases of adrenal insufficiency have been reported with opioid use, more often<< following>> greater than one month of use.

modes.description: The bracket, number or 'your' in the web notice 'This message is displayed if (1) your browser is not standards-compliant'.
